verify.subject: Confirm your {app} email address
verify.body:
Hi {username},

Please confirm your email address by opening this link (valid for 24 hours):

{link}

If you did not create this account you can ignore this message.

reset.subject: Reset your {app} password
reset.body:
Hi {username},

Someone asked to reset the password for your account. Open this link within 1 hour to choose a new one:

{link}

If this was not you, ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.

change.subject: Confirm your new {app} email address
change.body:
Hi {username},

You asked to use this address for your {app} account. Open this link within 24 hours to confirm it:

{link}

Until then your account keeps using its current address. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: nothing will change.

changed.subject: Your {app} email address was changed
changed.body:
Hi {username},

Your {app} account now uses {newEmail} instead of this address, so messages will no longer be sent here.

If you did not make this change, contact your administrator right away.

invite.subject: You have been invited to {app}
invite.body:
Hi {username},

an administrator created a {app} account for you. Open this link within 72 hours to choose your password and activate the account:

{link}

If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this message.

enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on for your {app} account
enabled.body:
Hi {username},

two-factor authentication was just switched on for your {app} account. Signing in now also needs a code from your authenticator app, and your other sessions were signed out.

If you did not do this, reset your password right away and contact your administrator.

disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off for your {app} account
disabled.body:
Hi {username},

two-factor authentication was just switched off for your {app} account. Signing in needs only your password again, and your other sessions were signed out.

If you did not do this, reset your password right away and contact your administrator.

reset.subject: An administrator switched off two-factor authentication for your {app} account
reset.body:
Hi {username},

an administrator switched off two-factor authentication for your {app} account, for example because you lost your phone. You can set it up again in your account settings.

If you did not ask for this, contact your administrator right away.
